name: Edge-Incidence Set Intersection
description: Replaces vertex adjacency with the intersection of edge-incidence sets (portfolios of event identifiers). A literal implementation requires O(n^3 * m) time or O(n^2 * m) memory, which will TLE or MLE. To achieve the required O(n * m / 64) time and O(n^2) memory, the model must mathematically deduce that the intersection of two incidence sets yields at most the single edge between them, reducing the condition back to standard triangle finding.
